title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:FRONT BUCKET SEAT LATCH (76,586 affected)
summary: SOME VEHICLES HAVE BUCKET SEAT BACK LOCKS THAT DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 207, ANCHORAGE OF SEATS. IN EVENT OF A CRASH, THE SEAT BACK LOCK MAY NOT FUNCTION.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (8,154 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL CABLE BETWEEN THE STARTER AND THE ALTERNATOR MAY RUB AGAINST A BRAKE LINE THAT IS ATTACHED TO THE WHEEL WELL ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDAL (1,327 affected)
summary: A COTTER PIN THAT PREVENTS THE HINGE ATTACHING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO THE FLOOR FROM COMING APART MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED.

title: DOVER: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER (72 affected)
summary: LACK OF LUBRICATION OF THE PINS AND THE WEAKNESS OF THE MATERIAL FROM WHICH CYLINDER PINS ARE MADE CAN DEVELOP INTO EXCESSIVE PIN WEAR. SUCH WEAR COULD CAUSE THE PINS TO SHEAR, RESULTING IN BOOM LIFT CYLINDER SEPARATING FROM THE WRECKER BODY.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER (27,120 affected)
summary: A WIRE LOCATED BETWEEN THE STARTER AND THE ALTERNATOR MAY RUB AGAINST THE HEAT SHIELD AT THE TURBO CHARGER.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SWITCH:BRAKE WARNING (5,800 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE WARNING SWITCH MAY HAVE COMPONENTS THAT HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED. BRAKE FLUID MAY SEEP FROM THE SWITCH WITHOUT TRIGGERING THE BRAKE WARNING SWITCH.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (24,705 affected)
summary: POOR ELECTRICAL CONNECTION AT THE FUEL GAUGE TRANSMITTER MAY RESULT IN A STOPPAGE OF THE FUEL PUMP AND ENGINE STALLING. IN EXTREME CASES, FUEL VAPOR MAY LEAK FROM THE FUEL TANK.
